ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 60:40 ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Centralized low-intensity black pigment zone radiating from the peduncle connection, covering approximately 40% of the visible area. Distal lobes feature high-intensity white fields. A distinctive J-shaped black marking is visible on the upper-right white field. Irregular black pigmentation is present on the lower-medial border of the left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Shallow V-shaped notch with an estimated angle of 120-130 degrees and low vertical depth relative to the horizontal span.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with pixel-amplitudes of 5-15 units on the right lobe trailing edge. The left lobe trailing edge displays smoother, lower-frequency variations except near the extreme tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical convex curve fitted to the trailing edges of both lobes, sweeping upward to acute distal points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense, high-contrast white circular pixel clusters (barnacle colonization) localized on the extreme distal tips of both lobes. Smaller, isolated white circular spots are visible on the interior of the right white field.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Three distinct, unaligned white linear pixel disruptions (scars) intersecting on the central black pigment zone. One prominent dark linear mark on the far-left white field.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Multiple white linear rake marks on the central dark pigment; significant structural modification of the lobe tips due to heavy barnacle colonization.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique J-shaped black pigment hook on the upper-right lobe white field and a small isolated black focal point on the mid-right lobe.
